sequence_unit: One independently initialized complete physical episode; all overlapping anchors from it share one group. Scenes E0/E1/E2 are strata, not independent groups themselves.
split: Assign independent episode groups to development/calibration/untouched evaluation before labels; no adjacent frame split; old12streams/3groups remain historical only.
coverage_required: initial estimated velocity and heading/tilt ranges
prospectively committed program and command-domain support
risk/unknown and scenario strata without treating unavailable as clear
measurement_required: held-out group counts plus privilege disclosure
not_frozen: actual collector and safe commitment consumer
stop: Do not collect or fit while not_frozen items remain; no numerical guarantees from synthetic traces.
